replacements.name: ModularKey Cryptanalysis Platform
replacements.summary: A proprietary classical cryptanalysis and modular-key analysis platform with deterministic transforms, key-period inference, statistical recovery and repository-owned validation.

replacements.name: Protein Structure Evidence Qualification Platform
replacements.summary: A provenance-governed platform for reproducible computational protein-structure qualification, evidence gating and candidate review with explicit separation of prediction and biological evidence.

replacements.name: Electric Flight Systems Simulation & Validation Platform
replacements.summary: A modular research platform for early-stage electric-flight simulation, flight-control prototyping, actuator allocation, fault injection, telemetry, Monte Carlo experiments and HIL interfaces.

replacements.name: Best-of-GitHub Agentic Engineering
replacements.summary: A proprietary control plane for discovering, auditing, qualifying, benchmarking, integrating and governing external software components for agentic engineering systems.

replacements.name: Vision Evidence Governed Multimodal Perception Framework
replacements.summary: A vision and multimodal perception research framework centered on evidence governance, reproducible evaluation and controlled migration of the validated v33 perception identity.

additions: A modular evidence-grounded reasoning architecture for capability routing, provenance, cross-critique, claim verification and traceable synthesis.
A production-oriented time-series intelligence platform for causal denoising, anomaly and degradation scoring, remaining-useful-life regression and evidence-backed model qualification.
A source-grounded autonomous documentary production engine for research, verified scripting, rights-aware asset acquisition, narration, programmatic editing, QC, rendering and publishing.

notes.legacy: The former perception repository remains private as migration evidence; it is not counted as a separate canonical public asset.
notes.currency: EUR remains authoritative. USD remains indicative at the existing ECB reference rate dated 2026-09-02.
